qcadsp_private_service.notes: The handler builds per-register codec operation lists from register IDs, physical addresses and operation/value pairs. It is a real ADSP hardware codec resource service, but its presence alone does not prove use by the SP11 speaker graph.

conclusion: The recovered Microsoft Surface REV_0D speaker ACDB/private-driver-data inventory does not carry the qcadsp audio_hw_cdc_reg_cfg private parameter family or any direct WSA-macro physical register address. Normal speaker ACDB calibration is therefore not the hidden source of a WSA register-operation list for this service.
remaining_question: Whether resource 0x0800131b is ever requested through another graph/runtime path outside the recovered ACDB private-driver-data pool remains to be proven by boot-zero host tracing or deeper graph-manager RE.
